title: CNF encoding of all transitions
statement: For a finite Turing machine $M$ and natural numbers $n,s$, concatenate the transition-gate CNF encodings over every input-head position $p<n+2$, every head encoding $h<(2s+1)^{k}$, every machine case, and every wire index $v$ less than the total width, where $k$ is the number of work tapes of $M$.
caveat: The meaning and ordering of the machine’s case list and the transition-gate encoding are not informally defined in the supplied material.
